sources.title: StyloAI: Distinguishing AI-Generated Content with Stylometric Analysis
sources.snippet: To address the challenges mentioned above, this study's objectives are twofold: first, to identify stylometric features capable of distinguishing AI-generated content from human-written content, and second, to develop a machine learning model that leverages these identified features to accurately classify texts across various domains as either AI-generated or human-written.
